payload.content: Under the GDPR, a controller must respond to a right-to-erasure request (Article 17) without undue delay and in any event within one month of receiving it, as set out in Article 12(3). That deadline can be extended by two further months where necessary, taking into account the complexity and number of requests, but the controller must tell the individual about the extension, with reasons, within the first month. If the controller decides not to act on the request, it must explain why within one month and inform the person of their right to complain to a supervisory authority.
